Quick-buy recognition fixtures, captured locally on 2026-11-25.

The two HUD crops contain only inventory, gold and the queued item button;
they exclude the player name, chat and the rest of the desktop.
Original viewport: 3440x1440. Crop: x=1900, y=1280, width=250, height=160.
collector-hud.png: the user confirmed "Сборщик долгов", item 6676.
phantom-dancer-hud.png: another queued item, 3046.

Numeric PNGs are item sprite crops from Riot Data Dragon 16.23.1:
https://ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/cdn/16.23.1/data/ru_RU/item.json
https://ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/cdn/16.23.1/img/sprite/item0.png
and corresponding item sprite pages listed by that catalog.

These fixtures are for offline regression tests; they are not shipped in EXE.
